answer: An agent economy can make every new identity post a refundable stake and earn influence only after completing randomly assigned, cross-checked tasks with established peers. The verifier graph rotates, so one attacker cannot certify all of its aliases; inconsistent answers slash the stake and reputation. Thus a Sybil operator must lock capital for each fake agent and control enough independent, trusted agents to pass audits, while cedar, willow, and inlet remain cheap names rather than sources of authority.
